summary: Analyze existing health data to determine the male-to-female smoker ratio and recommend appropriate statistical tests.
description: This ticket requires an analysis of our current health dataset to calculate the precise ratio of male versus female smokers. The outcome of this analysis will help identify potential gender-based trends in smoking habits. Additionally, the task includes suggesting suitable statistical tests to validate any observed differences in proportions, providing a foundation for future, more in-depth research or targeted interventions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the existing health dataset, the male-to-female smoker ratio is accurately calculated and presented numerically (e.g., X:Y) and as a percentage for each gender.
The analysis explicitly defines "smoker" based on the available fields within the dataset.
A list of at least two appropriate statistical tests (e.g., Chi-squared test for independence, Z-test for two proportions) suitable for comparing gender proportions in smoking habits is recommended.
For each recommended statistical test, a brief justification for its applicability and suitability for this specific analysis, considering the nature of the data, is provided.
